download_voc2007: download and extract the PASCAL VOC 2007 dataset including devkit, trainval, and test splits to a root directory
read_split: read the image paths for a given VOC 2007 split (train, val, or test) from the ImageSets text file
read_bndbox: parse VOC 2007 XML annotation files and return bounding box coordinates with category indices for each object instance
PASCALVoc2007: create a PyTorch dataset for multi-label classification on VOC 2007 returning one-hot labels indicating presence of each object category
PASCALVoc2007Cropped: create a PyTorch dataset for single-label classification on VOC 2007 by cropping each image to its bounding box and returning the cropped image with class label
